_doc: Step-Audio-EditX: the same sentences without and with inline tags or an edit pass (instruct), in English and German. Tags go in square brackets in the text; instruct e.g. 'emotion=happy', 'style=whisper x2', 'speed=faster', 'para'.

samples.text: I finally finished the report, and honestly, I did not expect it to work on the first try.
samples.note: Reference without tags, plain clone mode.

samples.text: I finally finished the report [Sigh], and honestly [Laughter], I did not expect it to work on the first try.
samples.note: Same sentence, tags directly in clone mode: are the sigh and laughter audible at that spot?

samples.text: I finally finished the report [Sigh], and honestly [Laughter], I did not expect it to work on the first try.
samples.note: Like en_tags, but the official route: clone without tags first, then a paralinguistic edit pass. No streaming, much slower.

samples.text: I finally finished the report, and honestly, I did not expect it to work on the first try.
samples.note: Emotion edit pass: happier than en_plain?

samples.text: I finally finished the report, and honestly, I did not expect it to work on the first try.
samples.note: Two whisper edit passes (StepFun recommends more than one iteration).

samples.text: I finally finished the report, and honestly, I did not expect it to work on the first try.
samples.note: speed=1.25 via mel interpolation in the vocoder (pitch is kept), no extra pass.

samples.text: Ich habe den Bericht endlich fertig, und ehrlich gesagt hätte ich nicht gedacht, dass es auf Anhieb klappt.
samples.note: German without tags. The model is not trained on German: listen for pronunciation and accent.

samples.text: Ich habe den Bericht endlich fertig [Sigh], und ehrlich gesagt [Laughter], hätte ich nicht gedacht, dass es auf Anhieb klappt.
samples.note: German with tags in clone mode.

samples.text: Ich habe den Bericht endlich fertig, und ehrlich gesagt hätte ich nicht gedacht, dass es auf Anhieb klappt.
samples.note: German with an emotion edit; does the second pass hurt pronunciation?

samples.text: Ein neuronales Netz lernt, indem es den Fehler über viele Beispiele hinweg schrittweise verringert.
samples.note: Typical technical sentence for reading aloud, without tags.

samples.text: A neural network learns by gradually reducing its error across many training examples.
samples.note: English technical sentence with the style edit 'news' (news anchor).
